capacity_gib.description: The storage capacity of the instance in gibibytes (GiB). Allowed values are from `18000` to `954000`, in increments of 9000.
capacity_gib.rationale: Google Cloud only supports specific capacity increments for Lustre instances to maintain predictable performance.
capacity_gib.compliant: A value like `36000` (a multiple of 9000) within the allowed range.
capacity_gib.non-compliant: A value like `37000` (not a multiple of 9000), or `10000` (below minimum).

filesystem.description: The filesystem name for this instance. This name is used by client-side tools, including when mounting the instance. Must be eight characters or less and can only contain letters and numbers.
filesystem.rationale: Only specific filesystem names are supported to maintain compatibility with GCP Lustre backend services.
filesystem.compliant: `fs1`, `fs3` — valid names within the allowed set.
filesystem.non-compliant: `abc12345`, `customfs` — not within the allowed name set.

network.description: The full name of the VPC network to which the instance is connected. Must be in the format `projects/{project_id}/global/networks/{network_name}`.
network.rationale: The full VPC format ensures the instance is bound to a valid and secure GCP network.

per_unit_storage_throughput.description: The throughput of the instance in MB/s/TiB. Valid values are 125, 250, 500, 1000.
per_unit_storage_throughput.rationale: GCP supports specific throughput tiers for predictable performance and resource allocation.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

instance_id.description: The name of the Managed Lustre instance. * Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. * Must start with a letter. * Must be between 1-63 characters. * Must end with a number or a letter.

gke_support_enabled.description: Indicates whether you want to enable support for GKE clients. By default, GKE clients are not supported.
gke_support_enabled.rationale: GKE integration must be explicitly enabled for Lustre to be discoverable and mountable by Kubernetes workloads.
gke_support_enabled.non-compliant: `false` or not set — GKE clients will not be supported.

description.description: A user-readable description of the instance.

labels.description: Labels as key value pairs. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
